description: OptiTrack - Gestión Integral de Cadenas de Ópticas, Contactología & Talleres de Tallado Oftálmico

scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json')); const parts = v.version.slice(1).split('.'); parts[2] = String(Number(parts[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0'); v.version = 'v' + parts.join('.'); fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)); console.log('Bumped to', v.version);"
